auto_save_note: Set auto_save to true only after the user has said so, and record the date and their words in auto_save_granted, e.g. "2026-01-15: just save them".

browser.note: All optional. selection_rule: where your own browser-profile selection rule lives (e.g. a CLAUDE.md section); when set, the skill follows it. name / device_id: hints for the built-in fallback (display name from list_connected_browsers, or its deviceId) for the profile signed in to calendar_account. Leave all empty with one browser profile.

session_link_note: Prefix for the session link at the top of each event description. Leave empty if your sessions have no shareable link; the description then starts with "Session: none".
